sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:6

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:6:1
items.html:
All the discernments of the inner SAG, hidden inside the inner MA and BON, rose. This ascent follows the manner of the ascents of the lights in the first departure with respect to the inner AK, and the manner of the ascents of the lights of the second departure with respect to the Partzuf AB. Its meaning is the refinement of the screen from all its coarseness entirely, until it becomes equal to the discernment of the screen of the Rosh [head]. This equivalence is regarded as the screen, and all the records included in it, having risen to the Malchut of the Rosh and having been included with her there in the coupling of the Rosh. And so it was in this Partzuf SAG: for after it is Mati [reaching] in the Malchut of SAG — that is, once the screen has refined to the level of Malchut — it goes on from there and refines completely from all its coarseness and becomes equal to the Malchut of the Rosh; the coupling in the Partzuf ceases, and all the lights depart to the Emanator. All of this is as explained above, Part 4, Chapter 4, in the Inner Light, item 50. Study it there well.
And it was explained there that the lights leave records behind them at the time of their departure. It was also explained that the screen, as it passes during its refinement from Sefira to Sefira until it refines entirely and comes to the Rosh, is included in those records. And so it turns out here: the lights of SAG that clothed in the inner ZON — (10) these lights, which had already mingled with the coarseness of phase four in the vessels below the Tabur — although they departed from there, they left records behind them. And these records of phase four were included in the screen that rose to the Malchut of the Rosh. Thus, when the screen rose to the Malchut of the Rosh, it brought with it also those records of the inner ZON, which are called the inner MA and BON.
And this is what he says: “And then all the discernments of the inner SAG, hidden inside the inner MA and BON, rose.” This refers to the records of the nine lower Sefirot of SAG itself, which are clothed and hidden inside the records of the inner MA and BON, which are of the discernment of the coarseness of phase four. And since the records of the lights of SAG are mingled with, and included in, the records of MA and BON, they therefore rose together, included in the screen of SAG, to the Malchut of the Rosh, and were included there in the upper coupling, as he goes on to explain.
And one should not object: it was explained above that the Partzuf SAG remains in the discernment of Mati and Lo Mati [not reaching], fixed and perpetual — so how can he say here that in SAG, too, a departure of all the lights to the Rosh applies? However, you already know that there is no absence in spirituality, and that all the changes we discern in spiritual things are merely a matter of added forms, while the preceding form is never annulled. So, too, here: although the departure of the lights took place here as well, after the lights of SAG mingled with the inner MA and BON, nevertheless the form of the perpetual Mati and Lo Mati remains in its place.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:6:2
items.html: And the inner MA and BON rose with them. This has already been explained above, in the adjacent item: the records of SAG mingled with the records of MA and BON, and all of them were included in the screen and rose together with it to the Rosh.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:6:3
items.html:
MA and BON are their MAN. The screen that rises to the Malchut of the Rosh in order to be included there in the coupling of the Rosh, so as to be renewed and to expand from there into a new Partzuf, after the manner of the two preceding Partzufim, AB and SAG — this screen has now attained a new name, “MAN,” which is the initials of Mayin Nukvin [female waters]. This is for the reason explained above in the adjacent item, that two kinds of records mingled here with one another: the records of the lights of SAG, which are the discernment of the coarseness of phase two, together with the records of the lights that clothed in the inner MA and BON, which are the discernment of the coarseness of phase four. And it is known that phase two is the secret of the first Hey of HaVaYaH, and that the coarseness of phase four is the secret of the last Hey of the name HaVaYaH; and they are two females. And since the screen, at the time of its ascent to be included in the coupling of the Rosh, was included of these two females together, it is therefore now called Mayin Nukvin, in the plural, being included of two Nukvin. And know that this joining is what caused there to be ten vessels in the ten Sefirot, and the correction of the two lines, as will be written below. And this is the secret of the association of the quality of mercy with judgment, for the first Hey is the secret of the quality of mercy and the last Hey is the secret of the quality of judgment, and they have now come together in the screen in a single coupling, as will be written further on at length.
And this is what he says: MA and BON are their MAN. That is, they caused the matter of MAN that was innovated from here onward in the worlds, since they are the ZON of the inner AK, whose level reaches up to Keter because of the phase four in it, as is known. And they were included and came into the record of phase two, which is from the lights of SAG, and they were doubled together in the coarseness in the screen, and were then called MAN, as above. And know that from the time they joined they were never again separated from one another; rather, the whole discernment between them is only in internality and externality: sometimes phase four is hidden within and phase two or phase one is without, and sometimes phase two is hidden within and phase four is revealed without, as it was here on the first occasion when they joined, as the ARI writes here, “the discernments of the inner SAG, hidden inside the inner MA and BON” — so phase two is hidden within and phase four is revealed outward. This will be further explained in its place.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:6:4
items.html: Their MAN for the Taamim of SAG themselves, which are not clothed in MA and BON. As explained above, page 391, the passage beginning “Therefore”: the Taamim [tastes] of SAG, which are the lights in the vessel of Keter of the Guf [body] of the Partzuf SAG, must end level with the Sium of the feet of AB, that is, above the Tabur. For since the male clothed in the vessel of Keter has the level of Hochma like AB, and the female in the vessel of Keter is included together with him, they therefore cannot shine below the Tabur, since they have no screen of phase four. Study it there well. It turns out that the lights of the Taamim of SAG are not clothed in the MA and BON that are below the Tabur. And this is what he says, that they became MAN for the Taamim of SAG themselves, which are not clothed in MA and BON — that is, for the ZON in the vessel of Keter of the Guf of SAG, which end above the Tabur. And the matter that took place here, and the light that is drawn because of it, will be explained below in its fitting place.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:6:5
items.html:
AVI to YESHSUT. This comparison must be well understood. For there are here two halves of SAG, and the difference between them is exceedingly great. They are: the upper half of SAG, which is the vessel of Keter of the Guf of SAG, called Taamim, which ends above the Tabur — it did not descend and did not mingle with the inner MA and BON, but remained in its coarseness of phase two and in phase three of clothing; and the lower half of SAG, that is, the nine lower Sefirot from Hochma downward, which are called the Nekudot of SAG — it did descend and mingle with the inner MA and BON, and two kinds of coarseness were doubled in it, that of phase two and that of phase four together. And he says that its upper half, which did not mingle with phase four, is called the upper AVI, and that its lower half, which mingled with phase four in the secret of MAN, is called Israel Saba and Tevuna. Remember these names well in their meaning, for the ARI uses them throughout all that follows.
And know that here was rooted the division of AVI into two Partzufim, called AVI and YESHSUT. And although both of them emerge from the discernment of the AHP that went outward, that is, the hairs of the Dikna [beard], as above, page 392, the passage beginning “In them,” where these AHP already receive from the discernment of the lower half of SAG, which is corrected in MAN — nevertheless, since they are complete ten Sefirot of a Rosh, and AVI are the discernment of the Rosh of the Partzuf, that is, from the discernment of the Nikvey Einayim upward, they are therefore regarded as not being included in the MAN, since the screen of MAN is set beneath them, that is, in the Nikvey Einayim, and coarseness has no effect whatsoever from below upward, as is known. But YESHSUT are the discernment of the AHP of the Partzuf, which extend from the Nikvey Einayim downward, upon which the screen of MAN already acts. Therefore YESHSUT are attributed to the lower Partzuf of SAG, which is already mingled with phase four.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:6:6
items.html:
The upper AVI couple and YESHSUT are included with them. The matter of AVI and YESHSUT of Atzilut has already been explained: that they are the discernment of a single Rosh of ten Sefirot, GE and AHP, and that through the ascent of the bottom Hey to the Nikvey Einayim they were divided into two halves of the Rosh. Its upper half, which is Galgalta and Einayim, is regarded as no longer joined with the phase four in the bottom Hey, since she is found below the Einayim, as above; these are called AVI. And the second half of the ten Sefirot of the Rosh, which are the AHP below the bottom Hey in the Nikvey Einayim, are regarded as joined with the phase four in the bottom Hey; they are therefore the discernment of a Guf [body], which receives from the Nikvey Einayim of the Rosh from above downward, as above. Now, for the need of the birth of ZON, these two halves of the Rosh join into a single Partzuf; for that bottom Hey in the Nikvey Einayim returns and descends to the place of the Peh [mouth], that is, to the Malchut of the Rosh, and then the AHP, too, return to the Rosh and unite with AVI into the discernment of ten Sefirot of a single Rosh, and then they beget Mochin for the ZON of Atzilut, as will be written in its place.
And this is what he says: just as, for the need of the conception of ZON, the upper AVI couple and YESHSUT are included with them, so here the Taamim of SAG couple with the whole AB, and all the more so do the Nekudot, Tagin [crowns], and letters of SAG join with them and are subordinate to them. The explanation is as follows. The matter of the birth of the Mochin of ZA was explained above: that then AVI and YESHSUT join into a single Rosh, and the coupling is made upon the screen of phase two in the general Peh of that Rosh, and the ten Sefirot that emerge upon this screen have the level of GAR [first three] of Bina, and these become Mochin and GAR for ZA. However, for the need of the conception of ZA, that is, for the Katnut [smallness] of ZA, it is not so. And although this coupling, too, must be made in AVI, who are always the discernment of the Rosh, here YESHSUT are included in AVI; for the drop of ZA, which is included in the NHY of AA, rises and is included in the screen of YESHSUT, and YESHSUT are included in AVI. (12) And the coupling is made upon the screen of YESHSUT, which is included as MAN in the screen of AVI; and the level that emerges upon this coupling is close to phase one, which lacks GAR. Then ZA emerges lacking Mochin, being merely the discernment of a Guf without a Rosh.
Now here, too, only the discernment of the Katnut of Nekudim came out at first, like the aforementioned ZA of Atzilut. Therefore the Nekudot of SAG, which are mingled as phase four, rose and were included inside the Taamim of SAG, which did not mingle with phase four and are regarded as the upper AVI, as above. And the Taamim of SAG rose to the Rosh of SAG with the MAN of the Nekudot, and the coupling was made upon the MAN of the Nekudot that are included in the Taamim, and not upon the discernment of the screen of the Taamim. And then the MAN rose to the Einayim, which are phase one; for the reflected light that rises from Hochma to Keter draws only the level of ZA, and it is this level that afterwards descended once more from the Tabur downward to the ten Sefirot called Nekudim, as is written at length in its place.
And this is what he says, “the Nekudot, Tagin, and letters of SAG join with them and are subordinate to them.” For the nine lower ones of SAG, which are Hochma, Bina, ZA, and Malchut, are called Nekudot, Tagin, and letters: Nekudot are HB, Tagin are MA, that is, ZA, and letters are BON, which is Malchut. And they became MAN and rose to the Taamim of SAG, and joined with them and were included in those Taamim; therefore the coupling was made there, in the Einayim of the Rosh of the Taamim, as above.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:6:7
items.html: BON of externality, and their garment, outward. Do not err in interpreting that the level of Malchut, which is always called BON, was born here. For the coupling that is made in the Nikvey Einayim is from the discernment of the coarseness of phase one, which is the level of ZA. Moreover, there is here phase two of the discernment of clothing, which is close to the level of SAG, as will be written below. Indeed, you will see that the ARI calls it BON of externality and not simply BON, and this is because it is in truth the discernment of SAG, as above (page 394, the passage beginning “The hairs of the beard”). And this level is truly called by the name YESHSUT, which is SAG; but since the discernment of the external AHP of this YESHSUT descended to the discernment of Nekudim below the Tabur, from which the root female of all the worlds is built — whose value is truly SAG and not BON, for the inner BON, which is phase four, remained entirely in the inner AK, and no discernment of a female was revealed from it in any of the worlds — therefore the Malchut of this YESHSUT, which came out through the Nikvey Einayim, is called BON, since it inherited the place of the inner BON, as explained. And this is what he says: and then they beget the discernment of BON of externality.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:6:8
items.html: (13) The female is now born first. As written in the adjacent item, the Malchut of YESHSUT that came out through the Einayim, from which the ten Sefirot of Nekudim were emanated, is the root female of all the worlds.
